user.title: Set up Earthquake Early Warning
user.description: Receives JMA Earthquake Early Warnings (warnings) through the P2PQuake WebSocket. Select one or more forecast areas. To use a finer subdivision, enter its P2P areas[].name value (for example, 神奈川県東部) as a custom value. Select no area to monitor all of Japan.

data.areas: Target areas (multiple allowed; none = all Japan)
data.notify_intensity_increase: Notify again when predicted intensity increases

init.title: Update P2P EEW settings
init.description: The integration reloads automatically after saving. Fine subdivisions can be entered as custom values.

data.areas: Target areas (multiple allowed; none = all Japan)
